about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am currently an undergraduate student at Changchun University, majoring in Electrical Engineering and Automation (2022.09 – Present), with a GPA of 3.71 (14/100). My coursework includes C Programming, Circuit Theory, Analog/Digital Circuits, Automatic Control Theory, Signals & Systems, and MCU Principles.
about.p2: Technically, I am proficient in C, with working knowledge of C++ and Shell scripting. I have hands-on experience with Linux driver development (Device Tree, Platform model, kernel porting and optimization), and peripheral drivers including GPIO, UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, and EtherCAT. I am skilled in STM32 Cortex-M architecture and low-level development of DMA, ADC, DAC, and timers. I also have experience with ARM Cortex-A series (RK3568/3588) industrial-grade Linux development boards.
about.p3: I have won 1st prize (province level) in the National College Electronic Design Contest, 2nd prize in the National Smart Car Competition, and the National Motivational Scholarship twice. I am passionate about exploring low-level embedded technology and enjoy full-stack embedded development from hardware to application.
